To verify that your connections to OpenSearch Serverless are using FIPS-compliant cryptography,
use AWS CloudTrail to monitor API calls made to OpenSearch Serverless. Check that the
eventSource ﬁeld in CloudTrail logs displays aoss-fips.amazonaws.com for API calls.
For OpenSearch Dashboards access, you can use browser developer tools to inspect the TLS
connection details and verify that FIPS-compliant cipher suites are being used.

hierarchy.parent: FIPS compliance in Amazon OpenSearch Serverless
